SELECT
                ha.firstname, ha.lastname,
                ha.flat, ha.address1, ha.address2, ha.address3, ha.address4,
                ha.city, ha.postcode, ha.phone_no,
                z.name  AS zone_name,
                ct.name AS country_name
            FROM orders o
            JOIN has_addresses ha ON ha.id = o.has_address_id
            LEFT JOIN zones    z  ON z.id  = ha.zone_id
            LEFT JOIN countries ct ON ct.id = ha.country_id
            WHERE o.id = %s
